**Is this scoped to an existing RFC, or does it need a new one?**
If it touches node identity, storage, networking, scheduling, security, or
the application runtime, please open an RFC first (see
[`docs/rfcs/0000-template.md`](../../docs/rfcs/0000-template.md) and
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)) instead of — or alongside — this
issue.

**What problem does this solve, concretely?**
Tie it back to the actual constraint tidsOS targets (heterogeneous,
unreliable, unmanaged office hardware) rather than a generic cloud feature.
